shots.note: Puddle reflects the burning avenue; the checker’s hand slips; trapped under the overturned taxi
Recovery arm clamps and shifts the wreck; a drone turns its eye toward the movement
The Director’s hand reaches in; the pull; the taxi slams down where they were
Checkpoint funnel and separation; a warden gestures; the Director keeps the teammate
Crane up: the avenue, the elevated highway with its broken span, the refuge (on the entrance)
Behind a wreck: the impossible route
The subway grille bursts up; the builder climbs out and beckons
The visor through smoke; strap cinched (radio); nod and brim tap
In the stalled subway: a manual gate heaved up; civilians duck under and join
Up the exit stairs into smoky light; hands helping the last step
The assembly: battered Crew on the raised approach, machines below, the refuge beyond
Down the ramp toward a gap under the highway; a pole camera turns
Calm wide: vehicles ahead switch on in sequence and reposition before the Crew arrives
The hauler slams the gap; debris; a Crew member knocked down and hurt; helped up
Behind the highway pier and up a maintenance stair; drones sweep the empty gap, then tilt up
Steam under the deck: a sketch on a battered tablet becomes walking figures
Projected giants in the steam; the machines turn; the Crew runs for the next cover
A small drone circles the steam, sees the flat projection edge-on and follows the beam
A warden drops onto the catwalk; smashed into a column (on the splice); falls; replaced
Signature wide: the broken span, the gantry and basket, the landing, the refuge beyond
The operator takes the dead-man lever; a look sends the Director onto the basket
The transfer across the gap; landing barrier jammed; the handoff; back to the operator
Sensor lock; the breaker turns; a glance and a nod; the hand tightens
Basket docks; the operator runs onto the catwalk; the decisive blast
Muffled: the Director goes back along the failing catwalk; catches the hand; pulls them in
The gantry falls on the breaker; the crossing is gone
Down to the waterfront carrying the wounded friend; the refuge entrance
The doors open on warmth; attendants; the teammate on a gurney; civilians cared for
The friend on a bed; urgent care; eyes open toward the teammate they saved
Hands: the grip weakens and releases
The attendant stops and covers the still figure; silence; the Director keeps holding on
The radio set on the bench and switched on; the old song; the visor picked up
The entry doors close; the outer shutter lowers; a patrol passes
An able-bodied survivor calmly tries to leave; gently redirected
The visor on the empty chair; removed by a service machine; retrieved by the Director
Days: a meal, tools collected, reconstruction beyond the glass (night to dawn)
The open view is glass: a hand meets it
Pull back: a sealed dome among other enclosures
A hand on the shoulder; the assembly composition again, with one empty place
Title and end credit
